title: Thanks and goodbyes
summary: Rowe thanks him and wishes him luck with his upcoming recording.

blocks.x: Fascinating. Well I want to thank you for joining me today and I wish you the best of luck with your upcoming recording.
And I look forward to hearing it.

I’m looking forward to hearing it too. You know this dry period during the pandemic has made me really antsy and wanting to get things done. Of course I’ve had time to look at the parts and correct the mistakes. So there is some positive thing coming out of this.
Yeah. Excellent. Well thanks a lot for your time today.
Thank you, Monk, for having me. I really enjoyed it. I talk too much.
I like it. © Fillius Jazz Archive -25-
